report.summary: Surviving findings: 2 critical (git-hardening-bypass, intent-before-effect-broken), 2 high (unused-admin-dir, cache-key-build-mismatch), 1 medium (token-budget-gap, auto-baseline-write), 1 low (egress-error-handling-mismatch, vault-slash-claim). Prioritizing critical items first.
risks: Changing offload.py to use attempt._git may break existing git operations if offload.py relies on direct git commands for a reason (e.g., needing a separate git process).
Enforcing intent-before-effect in ask() could add overhead and change API contract; callers must be updated.
Fixing admin_dir unused may require refactoring _run_with_ledger or removing the parameter, which could affect other methods.
Cache key mismatch fix may require significant changes to build_index if it reads env vars.
Token budget gap fix may require redesign of budget recording to be atomic.
Adding guard for write_baseline may be unnecessary if no automatic calls exist; risk of over-engineering.
Low severity items may not be worth the effort; deferring them to later gates.
todos: Settle git-hardening-bypass: run grep command to confirm offload.py uses direct git.
Settle intent-before-effect-broken: find all callers of ask() and verify they call record_intent.
Settle cache-key-build-mismatch: review build_index for env var reads.
Settle unused-admin-dir: search for self._admin_dir usage.
Settle token-budget-gap: add logging to track timestamps.
Settle auto-baseline-write: search for write_baseline calls.
Settle egress-error-handling-mismatch: search for documentation comments.
Settle vault-slash-claim: run vault_rel('note.md') to confirm behavior.

items.title: Force offload.py to use attempt._git for all git operations
items.why_now: Critical bypass of git hardening; every git operation must go through the guard to enforce security policies.

steps.do: Inspect offload.py for direct git commands (grep -r 'git ' daedalus/eval/offload.py | grep -v '_git'). Replace each with call to attempt._git.
steps.verified_by: Re-run grep; result should be empty. Also run existing tests for offload.py.

items.assumption: offload.py can use attempt._git without breaking functionality; the _git method exposes the same interface as direct git.

items.title: Enforce INTENT BEFORE EFFECT in ask() by adding record_intent call
items.why_now: Critical contract violation; any caller forgetting to commit intent breaks audit trail.

steps.do: Modify ask() to call record_intent and commit before proceeding, unless an intent already exists.
steps.verified_by: Run tests for ask() and verify ledger shows intent before effect.

steps.do: Update all callers of ask() to remove their own record_intent calls to avoid double-recording.
steps.verified_by: Search for all callers (grep -rn 'ask(' daedalus/) and verify they no longer call record_intent before ask().

items.assumption: The ask() method has access to the ledger and can commit an intent. If not, redesign may be needed.

items.title: Remove unused admin_dir from _run_with_ledger or document its purpose
items.why_now: High severity: dead code or missing functionality that could confuse developers.

steps.do: Search for self._admin_dir usage in attempt.py (grep -n 'self._admin_dir' daedalus/spine/attempt.py). If unused, remove the parameter and assignment.
steps.verified_by: Re-run grep; no results. Run tests for attempt.py.

items.assumption: self._admin_dir is not used elsewhere in the class; if it is, document its usage.

items.title: Ensure build_index cache key includes all environment variables it reads
items.why_now: High severity: cache key mismatch could serve stale indexes.

steps.do: Review build_index function for os.getenv calls (grep -rn 'os.getenv' daedalus/index/build_index.py). Add those env vars to cache key generation.
steps.verified_by: Write a test that sets an env var and verifies cache key changes.

items.assumption: build_index reads env vars; if it doesn't, no change needed.

items.title: Make token ceiling enforcement and budget recording atomic
items.why_now: Medium severity: budget may not reflect actual consumption if ceiling hit after dispatch.

steps.do: Refactor budget recording to happen before dispatch, or use a transaction to ensure atomicity.
steps.verified_by: Add logging to confirm order; run tests for budget consistency.

items.assumption: The timing gap is significant enough to cause observable inconsistency; if not, defer.

items.title: Add guard to prevent automatic calls to write_baseline
items.why_now: Medium severity: ratchet property could be broken by future changes.

steps.do: Add a check in write_baseline to ensure it is only called from explicit user commands, e.g., by checking a flag or stack trace.
steps.verified_by: Write a test that simulates automatic call and verify it raises an error.

items.assumption: No automatic calls currently exist; if they do, they must be refactored first.

items.title: Document error handling policy for vector indexing vs containment

steps.do: Add docstring comments to vector indexing and containment functions explaining that indexing errors are non-fatal while containment errors are fatal.
steps.verified_by: grep for the comments; they should be present.

items.assumption: The functions exist; adjust file paths as needed.

items.title: Enforce slash requirement in vault_rel or update docstring
items.why_now: Low severity: docstring mismatch could lead to security assumptions.

steps.do: Add validation in vault_rel to require '/' in the path, or update the docstring to allow flat names.
steps.verified_by: Run vault_rel('note.md') and confirm it raises an error (if enforcing) or passes (if docstring updated).

items.assumption: The security assumption is that all paths contain '/'; if flat names are acceptable, update docstring.
